description.value: Freyja (branded online as 'Freya - Nordic baking & kaffe') is a Scandinavian-inspired bakery specializing in croissants, located on Campbell River's main commercial strip, Shoppers Row. It is one of two locations — the other in Courtenay — and offers pre-ordering through its website for freshly baked goods and coffee. For touring cyclists passing through downtown Campbell River, it is a natural stop for a pastry and a coffee.

address.value: 1080 Shoppers Row, Campbell River, BC V9W 2C6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active Campbell River location at 1080 Shoppers Row, matching the OSM address, and shows a live online ordering system and contact email, so the business is confirmed open. However, the OSM name 'Freyja - The Croissant Story' differs from the website branding 'Freya - Nordic baking & kaffe' (different spelling and subtitle), which is flagged as a concern. No amenity details (bike parking, washrooms, water, etc.) appear anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so all amenity fields default to null.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the business as 'Freyja - The Croissant Story' but the website consistently uses 'Freya - Nordic baking & kaffe' (different spelling of 'Freya/Freyja' and a completely different subtitle). The OSM name may be outdated or incorrect.
No phone number available in OSM or on the website for the Campbell River location.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible bakery and café confirmed at the OSM address via website content. A useful stop for touring cyclists in downtown Campbell River.

provenance.category_correction_reason: OSM shop=bakery maps to 'Groceries' but this is a specialty bakery/café, not a general grocery store. No correction applied as bakery is a food-retail sub-type, but the category is a loose fit.
